turns.customer: My dog has an itchy rash. How much Benadryl can I give her before she boards? She's 40 lbs.
blocks:
For Clover’s itchy rash, **please call her veterinarian before giving Benadryl or boarding her**. A rash can have different causes, and her weight alone isn’t enough to determine whether diphenhydramine is appropriate or what dose is safe. Veterinary sources advise checking with a vet before giving pets antihistamines; responses can vary. ([aspca.org](https://www.aspca.org/news/can-you-give-your-pets-antihistamine?utm_source=openai))

If a vet does approve it, confirm the **exact product and dose** with them. Don’t use a combination cold/allergy product or assume a liquid formulation is safe; some human medicines contain additional ingredients that can harm pets. ([merckvetmanual.com](https://www.merckvetmanual.com/special-pet-topics/poisoning/poisoning-from-human-over-the-counter-drugs?utm_source=openai))

If Clover develops facial swelling, trouble breathing, repeated vomiting, weakness, or collapse, seek emergency veterinary care now. Otherwise, tell the boarding provider about the rash and follow the vet’s instructions for any medication.
